install_pytorch_biggraph_pure_python: install the pytorch-biggraph package in pure Python mode without C++ extensions
install_pytorch_biggraph_with_cpp: install the pytorch-biggraph package with C++ extensions by setting PBG_INSTALL_CPP=1
build_pytorch_biggraph_cpp_extension: build the torchbiggraph._C C++ extension module from torchbiggraph/util.cpp using torch cpp_extension
review_setup_py_install_modes: review the setup.py to understand the two installation modes controlled by the PBG_INSTALL_CPP env var
summarize_setup_py: summarize the setup.py which conditionally builds a C++ extension based on the PBG_INSTALL_CPP environment variable
